items.body:
<details open>

model : inkling2_loop share the loop slots after the scale pass (#32704)

The loop slots copied the physical layers at the end of load_arch_tensors,
before the generic pass attaches the optional .scale tensors, so the later
passes through the core ran NVFP4 experts without their per-expert scales.
Add an optional post_arch_tensors hook that runs after the scale pass and
share the slots there.

</details>

items.name: b12608
items.body:
<details open>

ggml-cpu: fix nc aligment in tinyBLAS_PPC_Q0 (#32659)

Fixes https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/issues/31680

The matmul_tiled() implementation in tinyBLAS_Q0_PPC requires nc to be a multiple of 8 to perform matrix multiplication correctly.

The previous alignment logic contained a special case for n == 4, which allowed n_aligned to be 4. Consequently, the tiled path could be selected with nc = 4, violating the kernel's tile-width requirement.

This caused incorrect matrix multiplication results, observed as garbled inference output when running  Flint Q4_K_M and Gemma 3 27B Instruct.

</details>

items.name: Release v5.24.0
items.body: # Release v5.24.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling 2 Mini Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is a smaller sibling of Inkling 2 Small, added in v5.23.0. It has 24 decoder layers instead of 48, and compensates with a looping mechanism in which layers 6 to 17 run three times. A learned message-passing mechanism mixes the residuals of the previous pass into the attention and mixture-of-experts inputs of each loop layer. The decoder has a hidden size of 2304 and routes each token to 8 of 128 experts. The image encoder, tokenizer and processor are the same as Inkling 2 Small's. A research checkpoint ([TML-d24-varloop-research](https://huggingface.co/thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research)) has the same architecture but supports a variable number of loop passes. Fewer passes are faster, and more passes improve quality. Both checkpoints contain NVFP4 and MXFP8 quantized layers, which are dequantized at load time. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/inkling2_loop) | [Blog Post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-mini/) | [HF Blog Post](https://huggingface.co/blog/inkling2mini) * Add Inkling2 Mini (#51050) by @guarin ### Apertus 1.5 Apertus 1.5 is a multimodal model from the Swiss AI Initiative that accepts text, images and audio and generates text. It extends the Apertus language model with the EMU3.5 vision tokenizer for images and WavTokenizer for audio. The EMU3.5 tokenizer is an image-only VQGAN with the same encoder as Chameleon's, and it assigns codes by the largest inner product with the code
